## Is ALTRUVA right for me? An honest fit check

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/is-it-right-for-me/

Is ALTRUVA right for you? Five honest questions, who it suits and who it does not, and where the money really comes from, before you put in a dollar.

### Is ALTRUVA right for you?
An honest fit check before anything else. No pressure: not joining is a perfectly good answer.

#### Five honest questions

#### Tick what's true for you

#### Who it suits, and who it doesn't

##### It may suit you if
- You want to learn how a smart contract plan works from the inside.
- You can keep your test small: the top package is $100.
- You like rules you can see on screen, in your own dashboard.
- You're willing to learn, take action and teach others honestly.

##### It's probably not for you if
- You need this money for rent, food, school fees or debt.
- You want a guaranteed return. There isn't one.
- You hope to earn without learning or sharing anything.
- You'd pressure friends or family to join.

#### Where the money comes from
That's the whole money flow. No outside revenue is named, so earnings depend on new deposits. When deposits slow down, earnings slow down. It's the most important sentence on this site.
What's the most I can put in?
The top package is Elite at $100, and the app itself says there's nothing more to buy. Go straight to Elite and your package costs $100, plus a few cents of BNB per action for network fees.
Can I open more than one account?
Some people do. That's their own strategy and their own risk. This guide explains one account.
So should I join?
That's your decision, and this guide won't make it for you. If it fits, the fairest test is from the inside: learn first, then try it with an amount you can afford to lose, and judge it by what your own dashboard shows. Not by what anyone promises, me included.

## What makes ALTRUVA different

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/what-makes-it-different/

If a smart contract platform let you down before: what is different about ALTRUVA, what is the same, and the questions to ask any platform.

### What makes ALTRUVA different
If a platform let you down before, you're right to be careful. Here's what's different, and what's exactly the same.
Isn't this just like the ones that crashed?
In one way, yes. Like every platform of this kind, payouts come from members' deposits, so when new deposits slow down, earnings slow down. That part is the same everywhere, and nobody can promise how long it lasts.
What's different is how the risk is shaped. Look at the six points below, then decide for yourself.

#### Six things that are different

##### A $100 ceiling
Three packages: $25, $50 and $100. There's no $5,000 slot to be talked into. Your package can't cost more than $100.

##### No promised return
No 2% a day, no fixed ROI. ALTRUVA itself says rewards depend on activity. A fixed daily promise is the red flag; this plan doesn't make one.

##### You hold the keys
You join from your own Web3 wallet. Your USDT stays with you until you choose a package and sign.

##### The contract pays
Working level income lands in your balance automatically. The rest you claim yourself. You withdraw whenever you choose.

##### Rules on screen
The app shows the daily matching ledger, pool sizes, your window on the global leg and every Lucky Ticket draw.

##### Reinvest built in
30% to 50% of each withdrawal goes back in as new business. It keeps money moving, and that part stays in the system.

#### Questions to ask any platform
Use these on ALTRUVA and on anything else you're offered. Good questions are your best protection.

Questions to ask any smart contract platform
| Ask any platform | What we found for ALTRUVA |
|---|---|
| Is there a fixed daily return? | No. ALTRUVA says there is no fixed ROI and no guaranteed return. Rewards depend on activity. |
| Where does the money come from? | Members' packages and reinvestments, shared by fixed rules. No outside revenue is named. |
| What's the most I can put in? | The top package is $100. The app says there's nothing more to buy. |
| Who holds my money before I join? | You do, in your own wallet. There's no account, username or password to hand over. |
| Can someone block my withdrawal? | You claim and withdraw yourself, by signing in your wallet. Nobody approves it by hand. Whether the contract owner keeps special powers is a separate check: see renounced. |
| Is the contract verified, audited and renounced? | Not confirmed by us yet. This page will be updated. Learn to check it yourself in the Safety centre. |
| Will it last? | Nobody knows, and anyone who promises you an answer is guessing. On Day 31 (24 Oct 2026) the app showed about 2.4 million USDT of business. Past numbers don't predict future ones. |

#### If you lost money before
That wasn't stupidity. Many of those platforms promised fixed daily returns and hid how they paid them. What you took away is priceless: you now ask better questions. Bring those questions here, and keep asking them. That's how you protect yourself, and the people you'll teach.

## ALTRUVA 100% split: where every dollar goes

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/how-it-works/

How every ALTRUVA package is shared: 40% global leg, 25% working levels, 25% level matching, 5% ranks and 5% Lucky Tickets, with a short video.

### Where every dollar goes
Every package goes into one smart contract on BNB Smart Chain. The contract shares it back to members by fixed rules, with no admin in the middle.

#### Follow $100
Here's how every $100 package is shared. Tap a colour to open its page.
40 + 25 + 25 + 5 + 5 = 100. Levels that nobody qualifies for stay in the contract, so not every cent reaches a member.
- Video: Explainer 1, "Where every dollar goes" (1:57): The 100% split: 40, 25, 25, 5 and 5, explained with a stokvel pot. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-1-where-every-dollar-goes.mp4
So it's like a stokvel?
A little. Everyone puts money into one pot, and the pot is shared by rules everyone can see. But unlike a stokvel, you don't get your own money back on a schedule. You earn only from deposits made by others, so nothing is guaranteed.
Who decides the rules?
The smart contract: a program on the blockchain that runs the same rules for everyone, every time. Think of a vending machine: the right coin in, the snack out, no shopkeeper. Whether anyone can still change that program is a question worth checking: see renounced.

## ALTRUVA packages: Starter, Builder and Elite

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/packages/

Compare the ALTRUVA Starter $25, Builder $50 and Elite $100 packages: global leg window, Lucky Tickets, ranks, and a shopping list for joining.

### Packages: Starter, Builder, Elite
Three fixed packages. Each one opens a wider window on the global leg, and the top one is $100.

#### Compare the three
Tap a package to see exactly what you need to buy it.

#### Your shopping list for Elite
- 101 USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20). One extra dollar covers small differences.
- At least $3 to $5 of BNB in the same wallet, for network fees of a few cents each.
- The sign-up link from the person who introduced you.

#### Ladder rules from the app

##### One step at a time, or straight to the top
The ladder is $25, then $50, then $100. You can climb it step by step or go straight to Elite.

##### Each package once
You can't buy the same package twice, and you never step down.

##### Reinvest doesn't upgrade you
Reinvested money grows your total deposit, but it never changes your package or your levels.
Which package should I choose?
That's your call. A bigger package opens a wider window on the global leg and more Lucky Tickets, and it also puts more of your money at risk. Pick an amount you could lose without stress. Why many choose the $100 position.
Why does the first purchase ask me to confirm twice?
The first confirmation is an approval: it lets ALTRUVA's contract use that amount of your USDT. The second buys the package. After that, your sponsor and your seat on the global leg never change.

## ALTRUVA global leg explained (40%)

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/global-leg/

How the ALTRUVA global leg pays 1% per member inside your window of 10, 15 or 20 seats up and down, with a worked $100 example and a short video.

### The global leg, 40%
Every member joins one long global line. You earn 1% each time someone inside your window deposits or reinvests.

#### See your window
20 up and 20 down are open: 40 members can pay you 1% each time they deposit or reinvest.
Example: a member three seats behind you buys a $100 package. 1% of $100 = $1 for you. That deposit pays $1 to each of the 40 seats around it whose windows reach it: 40 × $1 = $40, the 40%.
- Video: Explainer 2, "The global leg, 40%" (2:04): One long queue, your window up and down, and 1% per member. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-2-global-leg.mp4

##### You keep your seat
Your place on the line never changes, and new members keep joining behind you.

##### Claim any time
Global leg income builds up live. Claim it whenever you like, then withdraw. Nothing expires.

##### Outside your window
If your window doesn't reach someone, their 1% isn't yours. A bigger package opens more seats.
Do I have to introduce anyone to earn from the global leg?
No. The global leg pays from deposits inside your window, including people you've never met. But your income depends only on those deposits, so it can slow down or stop. Unlike a real queue, nobody gets served at the front.

---

## ALTRUVA working levels explained (25%)

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/working-levels/

ALTRUVA working levels 1 to 9 explained: the 10%, 4%, 2% and 1% rates, how your directs open each group of levels, and what happens to closed levels.

### Working levels, 25%
The people you introduce are your directs: level 1. Their directs are level 2, all the way down to level 9.

#### How many directs do you have?

Working level rates and how they open
| Level | You earn | Opens with | For you |
|---|---|---|---|
| Level 1 | 10% | 1 direct | Depends on your directs |
| Level 2 | 4% | 1 direct | Depends on your directs |
| Level 3 | 2% | 1 direct | Depends on your directs |
| Level 4 | 2% | 2 directs | Depends on your directs |
| Level 5 | 2% | 2 directs | Depends on your directs |
| Level 6 | 2% | 2 directs | Depends on your directs |
| Level 7 | 1% | 3 directs | Depends on your directs |
| Level 8 | 1% | 3 directs | Depends on your directs |
| Level 9 | 1% | 3 directs | Depends on your directs |

9 of 9 levels open: 25 % of the 25%.
- Video: Explainer 3, "Working levels, 25%" (2:09): Nine levels like a family tree, and how directs open them. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-3-working-levels.mp4

##### Straight to your balance
Working level income lands in your Withdrawable Balance. No claim needed.

##### Closed levels
If a level is closed for you, that share stays in the contract. It doesn't move to someone else.

##### Reinvest counts too
When someone below you withdraws, their reinvested part pays working levels like fresh money.
Example: your direct buys a $100 package. 10% of $100 = $10 for you. Someone on level 7 buys $100: 1% = $1, but only if you have 3 directs. Try the Working Level Calculator.
Is this a family tree, then?
It's a good way to picture it: children, grandchildren, nine generations deep. But nobody inherits anything. You only earn when people in your open levels deposit or reinvest, so nothing is guaranteed.

---

## ALTRUVA level matching explained (25%)

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/level-matching/

How ALTRUVA level matching works: the smaller side, the daily 25% pool and the real day 22 rate per unit, worked through step by step with a video.

### Level matching, 25%
Each day, 25% of the day's business becomes a pool. Your share depends on your smaller side.

#### Your two sides
New business today. Only the smaller side counts, so 300 is matched. The extra 700 on side 1 doesn't earn matching here.

#### The real day 22 numbers
- The pool 25% of the day's business: 25% of $124,304 = $31,076
- The rate Pool divided by everyone's matched volume: $31,076 ÷ 391,251 = 0.0794 per unit
- Your share Your matched volume times the rate: 100 × 0.0794 = about $7.94
- Video: Explainer 4, "Level matching, 25%" (2:19): The see-saw, the smaller side and the daily pool, with real day 22 numbers. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-4-level-matching.mp4

##### Grow the weaker side
Your stronger side alone earns nothing here. New business on your weaker side is what opens fresh matching.

##### One claim, all closed days
A day closes at 00:00 UTC (02:00 in South Africa). One claim collects every closed day since your last claim.

##### The rate moves daily
It depends on the whole platform's new business that day, so it can drop. Day 22 was one real day, not a promise.
Why did the presentation show $2.50 per unit?
That was an example in the slides. The live app's real day 22 rate was about 0.079 per unit. Always trust the numbers in the app over a slide. Try the Matching Calculator with today's rate.

## ALTRUVA ranks and Lucky Tickets explained

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/ranks-lucky-tickets/

ALTRUVA Nexus and Legacy Crown ranks explained, and how the Lucky Ticket draw shares 4,000 USDT among 250 tickets. Plain English and real numbers.

### Ranks and Lucky Tickets
The last two shares, 5% each: rank pools for qualified members, and a prize draw every time the pool reaches 5,000 USDT.

#### Two ranks

Ranks
| Rank | Package | To qualify (from the ALTRUVA presentation) |
|---|---|---|
| Nexus | Builder, $50 | Hold at least $50, plus 2 directs of $50 or more within 3 days |
| Legacy Crown | Elite, $100 | Hold $100, plus 2 directs of $100 or more within 3 days |

The 3 days start when you join: see Your first 72 hours. Rank pools are shared among everyone who holds that rank. You claim your share from Overview, like the global leg and matching. The split between the two pools isn't shown in the app, so we don't state it.
- Video: Explainer 5, "Ranks and Lucky Tickets" (2:41): Nexus, Legacy Crown, and how the 250-ticket draw works. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-5-ranks-lucky-tickets.mp4

#### Lucky Tickets
Each ticket enters one draw, then it expires. A prize goes to your wallet in full: no split, no reinvest.

Lucky Ticket prize tiers per draw
| Tier | Tickets | Prize | Paid out |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 10 | 100 USDT | 1,000 USDT |
| Tier 2 | 10 | 50 USDT | 500 USDT |
| Tier 3 | 40 | 25 USDT | 1,000 USDT |
| Tier 4 | 10 | 20 USDT | 200 USDT |
| Tier 5 | 20 | 15 USDT | 300 USDT |
| Tier 6 | 40 | 10 USDT | 400 USDT |
| Tier 7 | 120 | 5 USDT | 600 USDT |
| Total | 250 |  | 4,000 USDT |

Each time the Jackpot Pool reaches 5,000 USDT, a draw shares 4,000 USDT among 250 tickets picked at random. The app doesn't say where the other 1,000 goes.

Tickets per package
| Package | Tickets |
|---|---|
| Starter | 1, once 2 directs join within 3 days |
| Builder | 1 |
| Elite | 2 |
| Reinvestment | None |

A real one: one of my two tickets won 25 USDT in Draw 16. The other expired without a prize. Ticket ID hidden.
Is this a jackpot?
No. Think of a raffle at a school fun day: everyone gets tickets, a few win small prizes. Most tickets don't win, so never count on a prize. See how to claim a prize

## ALTRUVA withdraw and reinvest explained

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/withdraw-reinvest/

How ALTRUVA withdrawals split 50/50, 60/40 or 70/30 by total deposit, why you claim first, and a real withdrawal worked through, with a free calculator.

### Withdraw and reinvest
Every withdrawal takes your whole balance and splits it automatically: part to your wallet, part reinvested.

#### The split, by total deposit

Withdrawal split
| Your total deposit | To your wallet | Reinvested |
|---|---|---|
| Up to 5,000 USDT | 50% | 50% |
| 5,001 to 49,999 USDT | 60% | 40% |
| 50,000 USDT and up | 70% | 30% |

Total deposit means your fresh packages plus everything reinvested. You can't choose the split, and you can't withdraw part of your balance.
My real withdrawal: a balance of 23.63 USDT became 11.81 to my wallet and 11.81 reinvested. With a total deposit of 6,000, a 200 withdrawal becomes 120 to your wallet and 80 reinvested.
- Video: Explainer 6, "Withdraw and reinvest" (2:19): The automatic split, 50/50 to 70/30, and why you claim first. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-6-withdraw-reinvest.mp4

#### Claim first, then withdraw
Only claimed income is in your balance. Lucky Ticket prizes are the exception: they go to your wallet in full.
- Claim Move global leg, matching and rank income into your balance. Working level income is already there. Claim and withdraw
- Withdraw everything One tap takes the whole balance. The split happens on its own, and the network fee is a few cents of BNB.
- Check your wallet Your share lands in SafePal as USDT. From there you can cash out to your bank. Cash out to your bank
Is the reinvested part a fee?
No. It goes back in as new business: it grows your total deposit and pays working levels and matching to your uplines, like fresh money. But it never changes your package, it gives no Lucky Tickets, and you can't take it back out.
How often should I withdraw?
That's up to you. My own tip from Tutorial 5: withdraw regularly, because taking your profits out lowers your risk. Only use money you can afford to lose.

## Your first 72 hours in ALTRUVA

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/first-72-hours/

Just joined ALTRUVA? What may be waiting from minute one, why the $100 position matters, and what two directs in your first 72 hours open.

### Your first 72 hours
You've joined. Congratulations: you took action. Now your clock has started, and the next three days matter more than any others.

#### Your 72-hour clock
Saved on this device only.
- Right after joining, global leg income may already be waiting: your window looks up the line too.
- Once your balance reaches $5, claim and withdraw to SafePal. Half goes to your wallet, half is reinvested.
- Two directs on your package inside 72 hours open your rank, the Starter ticket, both matching sides and working levels 1 to 6.
- Video: Explainer 7, "Your first 72 hours" (2:58): What may be waiting from minute one, why the $100 position matters, and what two directs in 72 hours open. https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/media/altruva-explainer-7-first-72-hours.mp4

#### Minute one: what may be waiting
Illustration: if the 20 members ahead of you each hold $100, 1% of each is $1, so about $20 could be waiting to claim. The real amount depends on who is in your window.
Why is there money before I've done anything?
Your global leg window looks up the line as well as down. The app pays 1% of each visible member's total deposit inside your window, so the members who joined before you count from the start. It isn't a bonus or a promise: it depends entirely on who is in your window.

#### Why the $100 position

##### Twice the window
Elite opens 20 up and 20 down: 40 members. Starter opens 10 and 10: 20 members.

##### Two Lucky Tickets
Elite gives two. Starter gives one, and only once two directs join within three days.

##### The top of the ladder
Elite unlocks the Legacy Crown rank, and there is nothing more to buy.
My own example: Elite gave me two tickets. The first didn't win. The second won 25 USDT, paid to my wallet in full. With one ticket, there's no second chance.

#### What two directs in 72 hours open

What two directs inside 72 hours open
| Your package | Two directs of | What it opens |
|---|---|---|
| Elite, $100 | $100 or more | Legacy Crown rank |
| Builder, $50 | $50 or more | Nexus rank |
| Starter, $25 | $25 or more | Your Lucky Ticket |

Rank and ticket rules from the ALTRUVA presentation and the app. On any package, two directs also give you both sides for level matching and open working levels 1 to 6.

#### Your 72-hour plan
Build from minute one, one honest step at a time.
- Hour one: check and claim Open your dashboard, see what's waiting, and claim it. Tutorial 7 explains every screen. Dashboard tour
- Day one: copy your link Tap Network and copy your link. Share this website first, so people learn before they decide. The share kit has a ready message.
- Days one to three: help, never push Walk people through the join guide and the tutorials. They should join because they understand ALTRUVA, never because you rushed them.
- Before the clock runs out: check Look at your directs, your tickets and your rank in the app, and keep learning in your WhatsApp group and on Zoom.
Do I have to introduce people?
No. It's not compulsory, and the global leg can pay you without it. But the people you introduce may thank you one day, for opening their eyes to smart contracts, Web3, and a community that learns, wins and grows together. And you'll thank yourself.
What if I miss the 72 hours?
The presentation ties the ranks, and the Starter ticket, to the first three days. Everything else keeps working: the global leg, and working levels and matching open whenever directs join.

## How to join ALTRUVA with SafePal, step by step

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/join/

Join ALTRUVA in five steps with SafePal: set up the wallet, get USDT and BNB on BNB Smart Chain, copy the sign-up link, join, then tour the app.

### Join step by step
Five steps, one short video each. Pause the video, do the step, check your screen matches, then move on.

#### What you need
- A smartphone with the SafePal app (MetaMask or Trust Wallet work too, but the videos use SafePal).
- USDT on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) for your package, plus one extra dollar: 26, 51 or 101 USDT.
- At least $3 to $5 of BNB in the same wallet for network fees. Each action costs a few cents.
- The sign-up link from the person who introduced you. A pen and paper for your recovery phrase.

#### Five steps
The success check: the Packages page says you hold your package.
- Set up SafePal Install SafePal, create your wallet and write your recovery phrase on paper. Never type it into a website or send it to anyone. Set up SafePal
- Fund your wallet Send BNB on BNB Smart Chain, swap most of it to USDT BEP20, and keep some BNB for fees. Fund and swap to USDT
- Copy the sign-up link Use the link of the person who introduced you, so they stay your sponsor. If that's MTG, tap below: it copies and opens nothing. Copy MTG's sign-up link Copied ✓
- Join in SafePal Explore Paste the link in Explore, choose BNB Chain, pick your package, then approve and sign. Read the risk warning before you confirm. Join ALTRUVA
- Find your way around Tour Overview, Packages, Earnings, Network and More, so every number makes sense. Dashboard tour

#### Just joined? Your 72 hours start now
What may already be waiting, why the $100 position matters, and what two directs open inside your first three days.

#### After you join

##### Claim a prize
Check your Lucky Tickets and claim a prize, in full, to your wallet.

##### Withdraw
Claim first, then withdraw everything to SafePal.

##### Cash out to your bank
SafePal to an exchange, USDT to rand, rand to your bank.
What if something on my screen looks different?
Apps update their screens from time to time. Look for the same words, and go slowly. Still stuck? Ask the person who introduced you, or ask in the MTG TRIBE. A screenshot helps, but hide your balances and never show your recovery phrase.

## ALTRUVA FAQ: questions and myths answered

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/faq/

Straight answers to the most common ALTRUVA questions: before you join, money and risk, and using the app, plus six popular myths checked against the live app.

### FAQ: questions and myths
The questions people ask most, answered straight. Can't find yours? Ask in the MTG TRIBE.

#### Before you join
No. This is an independent guide made by MTG, an ALTRUVA member, to educate. The ALTRUVA app itself is at altruva.io/app.
No. Every page, video and calculator here is free. You don't need to sign up to learn.
The top package is Elite at $100, and the app says there's nothing more to buy. Network fees are a few cents of BNB per action. Some people open more than one account: that's their own strategy and their own risk.
A smartphone, the SafePal wallet app, USDT on BNB Smart Chain for your package, at least $3 to $5 of BNB for fees, and the sign-up link from the person who introduced you. The Join step by step page walks you through it.
Theirs. Your sponsor never changes after you join, so use the link of the person who is helping you learn.

#### Money and risk
No. ALTRUVA itself says there is no fixed ROI and no guaranteed return. Earnings depend on deposits made by members.
From members' packages and reinvestments. The smart contract shares them by fixed rules. No outside revenue is named, so when new deposits slow down, earnings slow down.
Yes. Treat it as money you could lose. Only use an amount that wouldn't hurt your rent, food or family.
Not for the global leg: it pays 1% from deposits inside your window, including people you've never met. Working levels and matching depend on your directs, and ranks need directs within 3 days.
It's a rule of the plan. Up to a total deposit of 5,000 USDT, half goes to your wallet and half is reinvested. The reinvested part counts as new business and can't be taken back out.
Claim and withdraw to SafePal (Tutorial 5), then send USDT to an exchange such as Binance or VALR, convert to rand and withdraw (Tutorial 6).

#### Using the app
Claiming moves earned income into your Withdrawable Balance. Global leg, matching and rank income need a claim. Working level income arrives in your balance by itself.
At 00:00 UTC, which is 02:00 in South Africa. One claim collects every closed day since your last claim.
A few cents of BNB per action on BNB Smart Chain. Joining in Tutorial 3 cost about $0.07. Keep at least $3 to $5 of BNB so you're never stuck.
Read it. Wallets warn about many contracts. Only continue if you understand and accept the risk. Tutorial 3 shows the screen.

#### Myth or fact?
Things you may have heard about ALTRUVA, checked against the live app.
Fact The top package is $100. Your package can't cost more, so in one account your risk is the package you buy plus small fees.
Fact The global leg pays from deposits in your window, including strangers. But nothing is guaranteed, and other incomes do need directs.
Fact Most tickets don't win. Each draw pays 250 tickets between 5 and 100 USDT. Never count on a prize.
Fact It isn't a fee. It goes back in as new business and grows your total deposit. You just can't take it back out.
Fact You claim and withdraw yourself, by signing in your wallet. Whether the contract owner keeps special powers is a separate check: see the Safety centre.
Fact No. Learn enough to explain it honestly, start small if it fits, and keep learning as you go.

## ALTRUVA glossary: crypto words in plain English

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/glossary/

Smart contract, Web3, renounced, BEP20, gas and more: the crypto words in the ALTRUVA guide explained in plain English with everyday examples.

### Glossary: crypto words in plain English
Every word you'll hear in the videos and the app, with an everyday example where it helps.

##### Smart contract
A program on the blockchain that runs its rules automatically, the same way for everyone.
Like: A vending machine: the right coin in, the snack out, no shopkeeper.

##### Web3
The part of the internet where you hold your own money and identity in a wallet, instead of a company holding an account for you.
Like: Cash in your own pocket, instead of money in someone else's safe.

##### Web3 wallet
An app such as SafePal, MetaMask or Trust Wallet that holds the keys to your crypto.
Like: Your own house keys. Lose them, and nobody can let you back in.

##### Recovery phrase
The 12 or 24 words that can restore your wallet on any phone. Anyone who has them can take everything.
Like: The master key to your house. Never give it to anyone, ever.

##### Blockchain
A public record book kept by thousands of computers. Past pages can't be secretly changed.
Like: A village notice board everyone watches.

##### DApp
A decentralised app: an app that runs on the blockchain. You open ALTRUVA as a DApp inside your wallet's browser (SafePal Explore).

##### BNB Smart Chain (BSC)
The blockchain ALTRUVA runs on. Fees here are a few cents.
Like: The road your money travels on.

##### BEP20
The token standard on BNB Smart Chain. "USDT BEP20" means USDT on BNB Smart Chain.
Like: A train must match the track. Send on the wrong network and it may not arrive.

##### USDT
Tether, a stablecoin designed to stay close to one US dollar. ALTRUVA packages are paid in USDT.

##### BNB
The coin that pays network fees on BNB Smart Chain.
Like: Petrol for the car: no petrol, no trip.

##### Gas fee
The small network fee for each action, paid in BNB. It goes to the network, not to ALTRUVA.
Like: A toll gate on the road.

##### Wallet address
Your public receiving address, starting with 0x. Safe to share for receiving. Always check the first and last characters.
Like: Your account number for receiving.

##### Verified contract
The contract's source code is published on BscScan, so anyone can read exactly what it does.
Like: A recipe printed on the box.

##### Renounced contract
The owner has given up the special owner powers, usually by setting the owner to the zero address (0x000...000). Nobody can then use those powers to change the rules. It doesn't make a project safe or profitable: it only removes the owner's controls.
Like: The builder hands over the house and melts the master key.

##### Audit
An outside firm checks the contract code for bugs and risks. Helpful, never a guarantee.
Like: A roadworthy test for a car.

##### Approve
Permission for a contract to use a set amount of your USDT. ALTRUVA asks for it the first time you buy a package.

##### Sign
Confirming a transaction with your wallet.
Like: Signing a cheque.

##### Claim
Moving earned income into your Withdrawable Balance, ready to withdraw.

##### Direct
Someone who joined with your link. Your directs are your level 1.

##### Sponsor
The person whose link you joined with. It never changes.

##### Total deposit
Your fresh packages plus everything reinvested. It decides your withdrawal split.

##### Reinvest
The part of each withdrawal that goes back in as new business: 50%, 40% or 30%.

##### Global leg
One line of every member in joining order. You earn 1% from deposits inside your window.

##### Matched volume
The smaller of your two sides in level matching, for one day.

##### 72-hour window
The first three days after you join. The ALTRUVA presentation ties the ranks, and the Starter ticket, to two directs joining inside it.
Like: A football transfer window: signings only count while it is open.

##### UTC
The world's standard time. ALTRUVA days close at 00:00 UTC, 02:00 in South Africa.

##### KYC
Know Your Customer: the ID checks exchanges such as Binance and VALR require.

##### ZAR
The South African rand.

---

## ALTRUVA safety centre: protect your wallet

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/safety/

Protect your crypto wallet: six safety habits, the scam patterns to walk away from, and how to check a smart contract on BscScan yourself.

### Safety centre
Six habits that protect your wallet, the scams to walk away from, and how to check a contract yourself.

#### Six safety habits
- Never share your recovery phrase. Not with MTG, not with support, not with your sponsor. Nobody genuine will ever ask for it.
- Copy links only from the person who introduced you, and check it opens altruva.io. Then reopen ALTRUVA from your wallet's history.
- Read every wallet screen before you tap Confirm. The approval should match your package.
- Keep at least $3 to $5 of BNB for fees, so you're never stuck.
- Only use money you can afford to lose, and withdraw regularly.
- Hide your balances and addresses before you share a screenshot.

#### Walk away if you hear
Each of these is a scam pattern, whatever name it uses.
- "Pay a fee to unlock your withdrawal."
- "Send me your phrase so I can fix your account."
- Direct messages from "ALTRUVA support" or "admin".
- "Send me USDT and I'll double it."
- Lookalike links with extra words or odd endings.

#### Check a contract yourself
Five checks anyone can do on a phone, for ALTRUVA or anything else.
- Find the contract address Ask the person who introduced you, or look in your wallet's history: the address you sent your package purchase to.
- Open BscScan Go to bscscan.com and paste the address in the search bar.
- Check it's verified Open the Contract tab. A green tick with "Contract Source Code Verified" means the code is public.
- Check the owner Under Read Contract, look for owner. 0x0000...0000 means ownership is renounced. Any other address still holds owner powers, so read what those functions can do.
- Look for a proxy If BscScan says the contract is a proxy, its logic can be upgraded even when the front looks renounced. Ask about it.
Can I take back an approval later?
Yes. BscScan's Token Approval Checker (bscscan.com/tokenapprovalchecker) lists the contracts allowed to use your tokens, and lets you revoke them. Revoking costs a few cents of BNB.

## Disclaimer

URL: https://mtgtribe.com/altruva/dashboard/disclaimer/

This independent ALTRUVA guide is educational, not official and not financial advice. Affiliate links, risk and privacy explained.

### Disclaimer
Plain words about what this site is, and what it isn't.

#### An independent guide
This is not an official ALTRUVA website. It's made by MTG, an ALTRUVA member, to help people understand ALTRUVA before they decide anything.

#### Education, not advice
Nothing here is financial, legal or tax advice, and nothing here is a recommendation to join or not to join. Always do your own research.

#### Affiliate links
The Sign Up button copies MTG's ALTRUVA referral link. If you join through it, MTG becomes your sponsor and earns by the plan explained on these pages. The crypto card guide is MTG's own crypto card website and may include his referral links too.

#### Risk
Earnings come from members' deposits and are not guaranteed. You can lose the money you put in. The top package is $100. Some people open more than one account: that's their own strategy and their own risk. Only use money you can afford to lose.

#### Facts and figures
Figures were checked against the live ALTRUVA app on 24 Oct 2026. Apps change, so the app on your screen is always the final word. Examples are illustrations, not forecasts.

#### Your privacy
This site has no sign-up, no cookies and no tracking. It remembers two things on your own device only: which videos you've watched, and whether you closed the menu. Fonts load from Google Fonts, and the rand converter asks CoinGecko for the live rate.

#### Names and logos
The ALTRUVA name and logo belong to their owners and are used here only to identify what this guide is about. The videos and pages are MTG's own work.
